title: The expansion was written and merged by AI agents in 6 hours 31 minutes
claim: On 2026-10-09 eight modules (a free plan and SMS for paying shops, a permission matrix, a customer's link and an installable panel, US dollars, a cash book, stock with suppliers, four more languages, a network between shops) and three closing passes were written by AI agents working in parallel worktrees and merged to main between 11:00 and 17:31 UTC, each as its own pull request with CI green and behind its own switch, off. 533 files changed, about 106 000 lines added, nine migrations (0038 to 0046); the back-end suite grew from 6 546 to about 11 550 tests. The nine migrations were applied to a copy of the production database (head 0037 to 0046) with every row count unchanged. Nothing was deployed, no new screen was seen by a person, Tajik and Karakalpak are unreviewed, and the network between shops had no review by a person. The coordinating agent had estimated several months before starting
